notes.title: Hobby Horse - DEMO RIDES OUT
notes.content:
HELLO THERE AGAIN HOBBY HORSING MANIACS 👋

As we said the demo was galloping and it's already here!
Before you play the game check out this video that shows you all the cool stuff that awaits you in the Hobby Horsing journey.  👇

[previewyoutube=y6tbLBBcht4;full][/previewyoutube]


Got ready and excited? So go try it out! 🐎
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348360/Hobby_Horse_Demo/

After you tried out the game and have some suggestions, ideas for content, crazy and exciting thoughts about the game you want to share, you can visit our discussions on steam. Also if you found any bugs and issues you want to point out, feel free to write them in our bugs discussion. We read everything!

📖 SUGGESTIONS & FEEDBACK

🐛 BUGS & PROBLEMS

Last thing, if you wanna share your hype, talk about the game, be a part of the community even more, please  WISHLIST our full game on steam and go visit our official Discord channel!


See you on the racing track! 🔥
